source.build_method: Two clean unprivileged aarch64 builds from the recorded offline pmbootstrap cache: apk.static materialized the same 199-package Alpine edge build root, proot translated child execs through qemu-aarch64 11.0.2-r1, and abuild 3.18.0_rc3-r1 ran with -F -d against the hash-locked local Weston tarball and four patches. Both runs used SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1784851200 and ABUILD_LAST_COMMIT=uncommitted-terminal-touch-scrollback-r3.
source.signing_note: Both APKs were directly signed during abuild with the readable canonical P2-track key pmos@local-6a5d38f2. apk-tools 3.0.6-r0 verified the retained artifact against config/lmi-p2-d114/pmos@local-6a5d38f2.rsa.pub.

verification.unit_tests: 13 passed, 1 skipped across 14 tests (tests/lmi_weston_sixrow with the official tarball and local r3 APK present; the disabled r2 transient exact-stage fixture remains absent)

known_limitations: The 350 ms selection hold is evaluated on touch motion; a stationary hold does not enter selection before touch-up.
A first motion after 350 ms chooses text selection even when that motion is predominantly vertical.
The frozen D114 r2/r10 userdata and disabled transient path still contain or pin r2; this r3 APK is not integrated into a device image.
claim_limit: This attests one exact local r3 APK, two byte-identical host builds, and static/model checks. It does not prove touch feel, terminal scrolling on the phone, image integration, persistence, or release readiness. The owner's RAM-boot rendering and Wi-Fi observation applies to the earlier r2/r10 image, not this r3 package.
